alt: The Coconut Breeze Body Lotion's complete ingredient list, 7 ingredients: purified spring water, organic virgin coconut oil, organic jojoba, plant-based emulsifying wax, organic grapefruit seed extract, organic red palm oil, organic coconut oil extract. The Body Cream has 8. Alongside, six ingredients commonly added to conventional lotions that are not in either: mineral oil, petrolatum, dimethicone, parabens, synthetic fragrance, lanolin.
